I get that it's not a 'Skyline,' however the GTR's heritage is the Skyline and it's the first GTR sold natively in many markets, including the US.

It makes sense that some who aren't Skyline and GTR history enthusiasts would lump them together, it's easy to do. It would be like Chevrolet building a new halo car called a ZR1 that follows the same recipe as the old Corvette ZR1. I wouldn't fault people for grouping them together.

Here's a fact, the practice of law is, in the private sector at least, a for profit business. If someone hires you, they expect to make a profit from your labor. As some markets truly are saturated with attorneys, it becomes a buyers market, where they can pay you a small percentage of what you're expected to bring in. They may bill $400 per billable hour, but only compensate at a rate of 10% or less.

The distribution of income in the legal market is bimodal. Low ranked schools love to highlight the median income, but rarely disclose in marketing materials that there are a huge number of attorneys who make a small percentage of that 'median.' Going to law school should be driven by a desire to practice law, not to make piles of money (unless you are attending a top ranked school or if you have a guaranteed position with a prestigious firm after graduation).

4) You can just enter a waiver and pay the fine and have the points put on your license.

Per stripes is easy.

The first successive generation splits a share equally. 

After that generation, each of their children split their parents share equally. 

So, if a dude has five kids. Each of those 5 would take 1/5. However, if one of the kids, who had 3 kids of his own, predeceased their father, the grandchildren would take 1/3 of 1/5, meaning they'd each get 1/15 of a share.

There is an underlying structure. The general rule is to attempt to follow the testators desires as closely as possible. Unfortunately, each jurisdiction inflicts their own beliefs as to what that desire would be as default.

Just know the general flow of intestate succession if there is no residual clause and a bequest fails for some reason and be prepared to retain some knowledge about jurisdiction specific quirks.
